messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for P1 - continuous-batching throughput cliff in prod (region: us-west-2). Alert: sustained queue depth > 6000, kv-cache evictions spiking, tail-latency > 5s on inference route /v1/generate. Pager: @maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): seeing the same on dashboards. Traces show a ton of inflight microbatches stacking, KV cache miss ratio jumped to 78%. Any recent rollouts?

ashwin: no model rollouts in last 24h. Autoscaler shows normal capacity. Looks like continuous-batching thresholds are letting microbatch sizes grow under high concurrency, causing head-of-line blocking.

samira: attaching quick metric snapshot: qdepth=6402, avg_microbatch_size=22, median_latency=1.1s but p95/p99 are blowing up. Customers on tier "enterprise-dedicated" reporting timeouts.

leo: saw a KV eviction cascade in logs around 17:12:41. snippets: ```WARN kvcache: evicting 512 entries (policy=LRU)
TRACE req=0x7f8a5a: prefix-miss -> prefetch-flood -> cache-regen```

maria (oncall): marking customer-impacting. Paging SRE. Samira, what's impact count?

samira: ~120 active requests failing with 504s in last 10m; majority are long-context chat flows. Customer-visible errors across 3 tenants (IDs redacted).

jess (sre): joining. Hypothesis: continuous-batching backpressure loop + KV prefetch mis-tuning under high concurrency -> cache thrash -> microbatch growth = O(queue * microbatch) -> tails. We should throttle concurrency and reduce microbatch cap.

ashwin: agreed. Two immediate mitigation knobs: 1) enforce microbatch.max_size=8 (down from 32) 2) apply short-term kv.prefetch_rate_limit to 50 rps. Both are runtime flags on the orchestrator.

maria (oncall): can you patch the flags? I'll coordinate rollout and customer comms. Also enable fallback to smaller model variant per routing policy for affected routes.

ashwin: preparing hotfix. Command to apply (will instrument):
```
# set microbatch cap and kv prefetch limit
curl -X POST "https://orch-api.internal/v1/runtime-flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORCH_TOKEN" -d '{"microbatch.max_size":8, "kv.prefetch_rate_limit":50}'
```

samira: also toggling continuous-batch.throttle_window=200ms to reduce batching hold times.

leo: note that forcing smaller microbatches will raise per-request compute but should collapse queue and stop kv regen storms. Need to watch unit-cost.

incident-bot: Deploy started by ashwin at 17:18:05 (orchestrator-hotfix/microbatch-kv-rate). CI checks ok.

maria (oncall): rolling to canary 10% first. Watch p95 and qdepth.

ashwin: canary applied to pool: cb-pool-canary-3. metrics: qdepth-> 4800 in first 2 mins, p99 still high (4.6s).

samira: canary -> 50% now. qdepth trending down to 2200, avg_microbatch_size -> 9. KV eviction rate dropped ~60%.

jess (sre): flipping fallback routing to smaller-variant for 2 heavy customer routes. command: ```patch /routing -> add fallback:model-small``` Done.

maria (oncall): customer comms drafted: "We are mitigating a performance regression affecting long-context inference. We've applied runtime fixes and will continue monitoring. Expect improvements in next 30-60 minutes." Approving send.

leo: at 17:31 qdepth=700, p99=1.2s, kv-miss=18%. Errors down to baseline.

ashwin: pushing the flags org-wide now. Deploy finished at 17:34:12.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (auto) at 17:35:00. Post-mitigation watch for 1h.

maria (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: we reduced microbatch cap and kv prefetch rate to contain a prefetcheviction cascade. Watch for increased cost per-token and any customer reports of reduced throughput.

samira: added temporary experiment flag to surface microbatch size per-request in traces: "cb.microbatch.size" so we can later analyze distribution.

jess (sre): immediate action items: 1) write short-runbook for emergency microbatch cap reset and kv rate limit commands, 2) schedule follow-up with runtime team to add auto-throttle heuristic, 3) run synthetic high-concurrency test to validate threshold.

ashwin: long-term: add adaptive microbatch cap that decays with queue depth and KV eviction rate; and a protection that disables prefetch if eviction spike detected.

maria (oncall): leaving handoff to @leo for next 60m watch. I'll update incident ticket and notify accounts. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

leo: ack, I'll keep monitoring. will escalate back if tails reappear.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: next_oncall=leo, watch_window=60m, incident_id=CB-2026-1768889999

maria (oncall): postmortem requested. I'll kick off a draft and tag runtime/product.

samira: copying useful logs and a short grep snippet for postmortem: ```jq '.events[] | select(.type=="kv_eviction") | {ts,message,entries}' prod-events-176888.log```

jess (sre): closing thread for now. Keep notes in incident ticket.
